plan.title: bug(capacity): label-aware completion stamping misses freshly-filed issues absent from the on-disk label cache

narratives.Description: The #2237 label-aware capacityBucket resolution reads labels only from the on-disk label cache (network-free), so a freshly-filed issue not yet in the cache misses and falls back to defaultBucket. Add a fail-open live-label fallback on cache miss.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer completing a just-filed bug in the same session, I want its capacityBucket to resolve to technical-debt (via a live label read when the cache misses) instead of falling back to new-capability, so capacity accounting is correct without a manual data-correction pass.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: 1. In packages/core/src/scope/capacity-stamp.ts, resolveCapacityBucket currently resolves labels via the on-disk cache (cachedIssueLabels) only. A cache MISS is currently indistinguishable from 'no labels' and silently takes the defaultBucket fallback. 2. Add a fail-open LIVE label fallback: when the cache has no entry for the completing issue, fetch labels via a single REST read through the scm shim (scm.call / restIssue* helper, PRs excluded). Only if the live read ALSO fails/returns nothing do you take defaultBucket. 3. Keep the cache as the fast path: NO new network call when the cache already has labels. Keep the reader injectable (labelReader seam) so tests are network-free. 4. Preserve all #2237 behavior: explicit pre-existing metadata.capacityBucket never overwritten; first-declared-match-wins; bucket ids read from PROJECT-DEFINITION config, not hardcoded. 5. Regression tests (extend packages/core/src/scope/capacity-stamp.test.ts): cache-miss + live reader returns [bug] -> matched bucket (technical-debt under shipped config); cache-miss + live reader fails -> defaultBucket; cache-hit -> no live call (assert reader not invoked). 6. Run repo-root pnpm run lint (full-file lane) + task check.
narratives.Overview: See https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/2246. During the #2245 finalize sweep, older bug issues (#1102/#1329/#1310) stamped technical-debt but freshly-filed #2237/#2238 fell back to new-capability (cache miss); they were hand-corrected on the sweep branch. Fix: fail-open live-label fallback on cache miss in stampCompletionMetadata.
narratives.GuardRails: TS-native repo. Route the live label read through the scm shim (verify:scm-boundary enforces no raw gh). Prefer REST over GraphQL. Fast path (cache hit) must NOT make a network call. Fail open: any live-read failure still yields defaultBucket, never a crash. Do not regress #2237's precedence/ordering guarantees.

items.title: Cache-miss on a bug-labeled issue triggers a fail-open live label read that resolves the correct bucket (technical-debt), not defaultBucket.
Cache-hit path makes no new network call (fast path preserved).
Live-read failure falls back to defaultBucket without crashing.
All #2237 guarantees preserved (pre-existing bucket respected, first-declared-match-wins, config-driven ids).
Regression tests cover cache-miss+live-match, cache-miss+live-fail, and cache-hit-no-call.
